name: @dolthub/docs-sites
description: Docs sites for Dolt, DoltLab, and Doltgres

scripts.install:all: cd dolt && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && cd ../doltlab && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && cd ../doltgres && npm install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.dev: npm run dev:dolt & npm run dev:doltlab & npm run dev:doltgres & wait
scripts.build: npm run build:dolt && npm run build:doltlab && npm run build:doltgres
scripts.preview: npm run preview:dolt & npm run preview:doltlab & npm run preview:doltgres & wait
